# R4.17 — Round-4 docs refresh: public-facing README/docs/AGENTS final for launch

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/167_R4.17__round4-docs-refresh.md` · **Run:**
`implement-spec` (`live_verification=false`, offline-only) · **Requirement
ids stamped:** `R-2.12.4` (docs half); the round-4 launch charter.

## Summary

Post-GATE-G6, the living docs still described the pre-Round-4 truth: a
52-crate workspace (now 54 — `hharness-tls` at R4.5c, the `hharness`
facade at L4.4), a `fixture-verified` ceiling with no `live-executed`
claim (now earned — 34 committed `hh-live-evidence/1` records under
ADR-0363), owed-work language for provider transports that have since
executed live, no live-provider setup story, no Round-4 build-state
paragraph, and a docs index missing the launch file set. This ticket
runs the contract's `refresh-repo-docs` → `agent-docs` passes and lands
every living doc at launch truth.

## Design decisions

- **No conform leg** — per the contract, R4.15a–e own it; only the named
  living docs changed.
- **`[0.1.0] — unreleased` kept** — HUMAN-H7 owns the publish act; the
  README Install section stays launch-final affirmative per the
  contract's own wording.
- **No new deferral, no deviation** — the round-4 zero-deferral rule is
  satisfied; nothing needed an ADR (no MET-DIFFERENTLY verdicts).
